question: The visually impaired do NOT feel secluded in the Blind Opera group because they can:
solution:
The correct answer is "**relate to their fellow performers**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **theme **of the comprehension passage is about blind opera, challenges overcome by blind opera members to impress the audience, and the purpose to reach the larger community of people with blindness who live in isolation. They want to establish a drama school that caters to all those who are economically and socially forced to stay on the periphery.
 
• In the **third **paragraph of the given comprehension, it is stated that they all share the same disability and perform together. So, they do not feel isolated anymore because they can relate to their fellow performers.

**Hence, the correct answer is option 1**
